title: LearnerObservation
description: An immutable observation of a learner attempt or action.

conditions.description: Conditions the learner states DID hold for this attempt. Absence is not a denial: a target condition named in neither this list nor conditions_not_met is unknown, and is never read as met.

conditions_not_met.description: Conditions the learner states did NOT hold — 'I had seen this one before', 'the prompt named the theorem'. Disjoint from conditions, and a different fact from silence: it makes the attempt a statement about a different situation rather than an unresolved report about this one. Without it, 'state that it was a different situation' was advice with no way to act on it (review workbench/audits/repair-review-2026-09-13, D4).
